title: Use atomic os.replace for state.json writes
claim: All plugin state writes go through temp file + os.replace to guarantee Claude Code never observes a partially written state file.
why_it_matters: Claude Code reads state.json on each SessionStart; a half-written file would cause env-detection branches to fire incorrectly and bypass the env gate.
evidence: hooks/hooks.json declares timeout 5; concurrent writer smoke test in test_hook_runtime.py::test_session_start_writes_state_marker.
applies_when: any new script in plugins/nowledge-mem-ralph/scripts that writes state.json or recall.json
verification: pytest plugins/nowledge-mem-ralph/tests/ shows no torn writes across 3 concurrent SessionStart processes.
